report.summary: All surviving findings are needs-evidence; confirmed ones are docstring drift and keyerror risk. Plan: gate 0 audits and contract tests, then gate 1 fixes.
risks: Most findings are unverified; audits may reveal no defect, wasting effort.
Fixes may introduce behavior changes if docstrings were intentional design intent.
Cross-module contract tests may be brittle and require significant test infrastructure.
Some fixes depend on other modules not yet audited; ordering may change after evidence.
todos: Run settling checks for all needs-evidence findings to confirm or refute.
Prioritize confirmed high-severity items: keyerror-unguarded, nevery-raises-broken, docstring-contract-vs-implementation.
Audit snapshot freshness and add guard if missing.
Audit provider guard duplication and centralize if drift found.
Audit gate fail-closed logic for unavailable vs failure.
Add contract tests for cross-module guarantees.

items.title: Add freshness check to snapshot verification path
items.why_now: Confirmed high severity: stale snapshots can be trusted by the self-improvement loop, causing wrong decisions.

steps.do: Inspect snapshot verification code and self-improvement loop for timestamp checks
If missing, add a freshness threshold check to the verification function and enforce it in the self-improvement loop
steps.verified_by: Unit test that passes a stale snapshot and expects rejection

items.assumption: The freshness threshold is not already enforced elsewhere; the exact location of the verification function is UNKNOWN.

items.title: Add guard for missing 'repo' key in eval_task_arms and eval_task_tier1
items.why_now: Confirmed high severity: unguarded dict access can raise KeyError, violating the 'never raises' contract and potentially crashing.

steps.do: Inspect the full implementations of eval_task_arms and eval_task_tier1 to confirm unguarded access
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'def eval_task_arms\|def eval_task_tier1' daedalus/ and review

steps.do: If unguarded, add a check that raises a documented exception or returns a failure result
steps.verified_by: Unit test passing a task dict without 'repo' and expecting a controlled failure

items.assumption: The functions are in files not named in the input; exact paths UNKNOWN.

items.title: Align docstrings with actual behavior for refusal receipt, evaluate_change, write_snapshot, and others
items.why_now: Confirmed high severity: misleading docstrings cause incorrect assumptions in callers and maintenance.

steps.do: Identify all confirmed docstring mismatches (e.g., refusal receipt claims 'LABEL only' but includes meta; evaluate_change claims 'never raises' but may raise; write_snapshot claims excluding modules but doesn't filter)
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'LABEL only' daedalus/refusal.py; grep -n 'never raises' daedalus/eval.py; inspect write_snapshot

steps.do: Update docstrings to reflect actual behavior, or fix code to match promises if the promises are intended
steps.verified_by: Review diff and ensure no behavior change unless intended

items.assumption: The intended behavior is the documented one; if not, code changes may be needed.

items.title: Audit and centralize provider guard implementations to prevent drift
items.why_now: High severity if drift exists: security postures can diverge, leaving some providers unprotected.

steps.do: Compare guard logic across providers (deepseek.py, ollama.py) to identify duplication and inconsistencies
If duplication found, extract common guard into a shared module and have providers call it
steps.verified_by: Unit tests for each provider's guard behavior

items.assumption: Providers are in daedalus/adapters/; exact filenames UNKNOWN.

items.title: Audit gate fail-closed logic for 'unavailable' statuses
items.why_now: High severity if misclassified: canary 'unavailable' may be treated as failure, blocking legitimate operations.

steps.do: Inspect gate's failure logic and canary status handling
If 'unavailable' is treated as failure, exclude it from failure statuses and add a test
steps.verified_by: Unit test that a canary with 'unavailable' status does not fail the gate

items.assumption: The gate logic is in files not named; exact paths UNKNOWN.

items.title: Add contract tests for cross-module guarantees
items.why_now: High severity: many needs-evidence findings indicate cross-module assumptions that could break without local tests.

steps.do: Identify the cross-module claims from surviving findings (e.g., provider reachability in tier2, egress policy enforcement, baseline update semantics)
Write integration tests that exercise both modules together and verify the claim
steps.verified_by: Run the new tests and ensure they pass

items.depends_on: Audit and centralize provider guard implementations to prevent drift
items.assumption: The integration test infrastructure exists; if not, additional setup is needed.

items.title: Resolve all needs-evidence findings by running settling checks
items.why_now: Many findings are unverified; settling checks will confirm or refute them, allowing accurate prioritization.

steps.do: For each needs-evidence finding, run the specified settling check (e.g., inspect full function, grep for patterns)
steps.verified_by: Document results and update the finding status

items.assumption: The settling checks are feasible and will provide definitive answers.
